stem: A nine-point PPFD map has a good average but much brighter center points and dim corners. What should the technician report?
choices: Only the average because it summarizes the room
The distribution and representative grid values, not only the average
Only the center because it is brightest
rationale: The distribution and representative grid values, not only the average. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
